---
name: daisyui-ux
description: daisyUI 5 + Tailwind 4 UI conventions. Use when building or styling components, layouts, themes, modals, forms.
---
- Use daisyUI classes (`btn`, `card`, `modal`, `alert`, `input`); no custom rebuilds.
- Semantic tokens only (`btn-primary`, `bg-base-100`, `text-base-content`).
- Semantic HTML (`main`, `section`, `nav`).
- Icons from `@lucide/vue`.
- `range` is single-thumb; use two inputs for min/max.
- Docs: https://daisyui.com/
